alex: Noticed an unusual uptick in per-model unit cost for the prefetch path on the daily cost dashboard. Looks specific to a small canary we flipped yesterday. :confused:
rachel: which model / tenant cohort? any quick query you ran?
alex: m-core-lite, tenants tagged as latency-tier=low. Quick sanity query: `SELECT route, model, SUM(tokens)*unit_price AS raw_cost, SUM(applied_credit) AS credits FROM token_events WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY route,model` -> prefetch rows have credits=0 while traces show prefetch hits.
nate: router emitted `x-prefetch` header for the cohort, but ingest sometimes expects `x-cache-credit`. we changed a header name in the rollout last week and might have missed a mapping.
rachel: UX-wise this is nasty: product owners see the raw cost and jump to conclusions. we should not show raw-unadjusted cost as the default when a rollout is active and credits are likely pending.
ui-bot: rollout-pegasus started by @releasebot at 2026-05-02T13:45:00Z targeting 10% traffic.
ops-bot: action queued: pause-rollout pegasus (reason: econ-credit-investigation)
alex: thanks ops-bot. proposal: add two dashboard changes: 1) a `provisional_post_credit_cost` column that shows estimated cost when credits missing; 2) a small banner for the time window with link to the active ticket. color estimated rows in amber and add tooltip "Estimated after credits; final billing may vary".
nate: backend plan: 1) make econ-ingest accept both `x-cache-credit` and `x-rw-cache-credit` with a header-mapping shim; 2) run a reconciler to backfill estimated credits for invocations with route='prefetch' and missing credit header for last 48h. mark backfills as `estimated` and emit audit events.
rachel: can you paste a SQL sketch for the backfill?
nate: sure, rough sketch: ```
-- backfill estimated credits for prefetch invocations missing applied credits
INSERT INTO econ_adjustments (invocation_id, estimated_credit, reason, created_by)
SELECT i.id,
       LEAST(i.estimated_kv_savings, i.token_cost * 0.8) AS estimated_credit,
       'prefetch-header-mapping-backfill',
       'reconciler-v1'
FROM invocations i
LEFT JOIN econ_adjustments e ON e.invocation_id = i.id
WHERE i.route = 'prefetch'
  AND i.ts > now() - interval '48 hours'
  AND e.invocation_id IS NULL;
```
ui-bot: note: when estimated_credit is used, UI should show an info icon linking to the reconciler run id.
alex: also add a short-lived alert rule that notifies econ-channel (no page) when (sum(raw_cost) - sum(post_credit_cost)) / sum(raw_cost) > 0.4 for > 10m for any tenant. if reconciliation changes billed amounts > 0.5% for a tenant, escalate to finance + CS.
rachel: tests: econ-tests must simulate header rename and missing header multiplexing cases, then run reconciler in CI and assert credits move from null -> estimated. also add a dashboard e2e that toggles provisional view.
nate: will implement header shim + reconciler. i'll tag backfills with run id and emit `audit_event` rows so finance can inspect.
ops-bot: FYI: we've paused the canary. please keep ops-bot updated to resume.
alex: i'll open ENG-8010 (header-mapping + reconciler), ENG-8011 (dashboard provisional UX), ENG-8012 (e2e tests). rachel, can you mock the UI change so we can iterate quickly?
rachel: will do a small PR with `provisional_post_credit_cost` and the banner. linking to the ticket in the banner.
alex: thanks team. once backfill runs we'll evaluate net billing impact and decide if a brief postmortem is needed. :thumbsup:
